title: Melted Screws
about: A humorous memory of forcing a stubborn wall into place during State Arts-In prep week.
description: This track retells one of those backstage stories every tech crew seems to collect. Faced with a wall and platform that refused to line up, we kept pushing, drilling, laughing, and sacrificing screw after screw until it finally worked. It's a lighthearted tribute to improvisation, teamwork, and the kind of engineering that only exists backstage when the show has to go on.
lyrics: "Just make the wall line up somehow..."
Tony and I lined them up,
Or tried the best we could.
The platform swore it fit just fine.
The pieces didn't want to meet,
But we insisted that they should.
Hot enough to lose their heads.
Smoke and laughter drifting through the air.
But eventually the wall stayed there.
We pushed the stubborn wall in place,
The screw went in about halfway,
By screw number five we all agreed...
And this wall had drawn a line.
Hot enough to lose their heads.
Smoke and laughter drifting through the air.
But eventually the wall stayed there.
By screw number five we learned
The wall would fight us all the way.
Hot enough to lose their heads.
Smoke and laughter drifting through the air.
But eventually the wall stayed there.
So we held the whole thing steady
And refused to let it part.
A tiny piece of Tech Crew lore, loud and true.
Then we drove in two screws more.
The audience sees a perfect set...
